description: Deterministic, network-free contracts for the pinned Oracle sample OCI Object Storage, Notifications, ORDS, Logging, and Log Analytics nodes, plus the iot-get-content versus ORDS snapshot distinction. No OCI SDK, ORDS, filesystem, token, logging, subscriber, or target-palette call is made.

sourceEvidence.role: Oracle sample node reference and implementation files
sourceEvidence.anchor: docs lines 592-729; exact node anchors are in contracts

sourceEvidence.role: official Object Storage batch scenario role

oci-object-storage.precedence: non-null/non-empty runtime msg fields override configured values; configured operation is used when msg.operation is absent; operation is resolved before the download/upload branch and before OCI client acquisition
oci-object-storage.fileVsPayload: upload payload wins over file; download with file writes the exact path and still returns content in payload wrapper

oci-notification.precedence: topic and title use non-empty runtime values first; configured non-empty body wins and otherwise payload is stringified
oci-notification.deliveryBoundary: publish acceptance is not subscriber delivery

ords-config.precedence: config owns base/token URL and credentials; runtime child nodes select query/header/body values
ords-config.urlRequirement: baseUrl and tokenUrl must be HTTPS
outputs: cached bearer token to child nodes
ords-config.safety: HTTPS-only; one refresh after 401; active requests abort and queued polls reject on close

oci-ords-request.precedence: runtime operation/method/recordId/customPath/query/headers override or extend configured values; configured body is used only when configured method permits it, otherwise body-capable runtime method uses msg.payload

oci-ords-poll.precedence: runtime recordId/customPath/query/intervalMs/timeoutMs override configured values; shared concurrency/queue bounds remain on ords-config
oci-ords-poll.polling: commandStatus uses /20250531/rawCommandData/<recordId>; custom uses relative path and finite stop condition
oci-ords-poll.responseDataOnlyCompletion: waitFor=response completes on present response_data even when status is absent; the emitted deliveryStatus is null, never the string UNDEFINED

oci-logging.precedence: logId is config first then msg fallback; non-empty runtime source/type/severity override; mappings or direct payload is selected by configured payloadSource
oci-logging.api: LoggingClient.putLogs; serialized entry is below 1 MiB

oci-log-analytics.precedence: configured namespace/logGroupOcid/logSourceName/entityOcid win when non-empty, otherwise runtime fallback; runtime severity overrides
oci-log-analytics.api: LogAnalyticsClient.uploadLogEventsFile; serialized payload is below 1 MiB

iot-get-content-distinction.distinction: calls getDigitalTwinInstanceContent; does not call ORDS, use snapshotData, or poll

invariants: all seven optional node identities are source-owned by the pinned S4 package and remain target-compatibility-gated
official C11/C12 scenario roles do not establish exact package node installation
runtime precedence is explicit and differs by node; blank values do not universally clear configured values
Object Storage resolves operation and required identifiers before service call; configured download and runtime operation override select their respective branches
Object Storage upload payload and file fallback, and download file write plus payload return, remain distinct
oci-ords-request is one-shot; oci-ords-poll is bounded by finite interval, timeout, concurrency, and queue limits
ORDS command polling unwraps direct rows, items[0], item, and value envelopes; response_data can complete without inventing an UNDEFINED delivery status
ORDS refreshes at most once after 401 and never performs an implicit generic resend loop
iot-get-content uses OCI IoT SDK content retrieval and is distinct from the ORDS snapshotData preset
OCI Logging putLogs and Log Analytics uploadLogEventsFile are separate APIs and acceptance does not prove searchability or delivery
fixtures contain synthetic identifiers and paths only and prove no live service, target palette, filesystem, or downstream state
